sub-flow.name: insert-patient
sub-flow.doc:description: Inserts a patient record and reads it back as stored

db:insert.doc:name: Insert patient
db:insert.doc:description: Inserts the record unless the identity (name + birth date) already exists
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO patient (given_name, family_name, birth_date, sex, category, email, phone, consent_data_processing, consent_sms, source) VALUES (:given_name, :family_name, CAST(:birth_date AS DATE), :sex, :category, :email, CAST(:phone AS VARCHAR), :consent_data_processing, :consent_sms, :source) ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_patient_identity DO NOTHING

choice.doc:description: Detects a record rejected by the unique identity constraint

when.doc:name: Duplicate identity
when.doc:description: No row was inserted because the identity already exists

logger.doc:name: Log patient stored
logger.doc:description: Logs the generated patient ID (no patient data)

flow-ref.name: find-patient-by-id
flow-ref.doc:name: Read back stored patient
flow-ref.doc:description: Returns the record exactly as stored, with generated status and timestamp

sub-flow.name: find-patient-by-id
sub-flow.doc:description: Selects one patient by vars.patientId and maps it to the record contract

db:select.doc:name: Select patient
db:select.doc:description: Selects the patient row; dates are formatted in SQL to avoid JVM time-zone shifts
db:select.db:sql: SELECT patient_id, given_name, family_name, to_char(birth_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth_date, sex, category, email, phone, consent_data_processing, consent_sms, source, status, CAST(floor(extract(EPOCH FROM registered_at)) AS BIGINT) AS registered_epoch FROM patient WHERE patient_id = :patient_id

raise-error.description: No patient row for the requested ID
raise-error.doc:name: Raise PATIENT_NOT_FOUND

ee:transform.doc:name: Row to record
ee:transform.doc:description: Maps the selected row to the snake_case record contract

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import fromRow from dwl::PatientRecords output application/json --- fromRow(payload[0])
